register.source_checks:
The issue says this repository's packing-witness verify, run unmodified on the witness at main 0352d755, reports VERIFIED (exact-algebraic, 36046 pairs), and that verifier/sqcheck.py, an exact checker the author's lab wrote separately from this repository's code, reports VALID (exact rational) and prints the exact side rounded up. It says the two share only the unit-square, wall and non-overlap definitions.

This repository's packing-witness promote --strategy robust-rational at 0352d755 made the exact coordinates from the lab's decimal pose, n-269-decimal-pose.yaml, with center_dilation 1 and no dilation, so packing-witness verify is not independent of how they were rounded, as the issue says. The issue says the pair margins of about 2e-13 are the decimal pose's own, that only the squares that set the left wall, the bottom wall and the side touch them exactly, and that other squares near a wall clear it by up to about 1e-12. Before promotion sqcheck.py certified the decimal pose in interval arithmetic at its own side. No local-optimality, rigidity or formal check is claimed. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
